dcterms:description: A dataset used to predict students' first-year average grade based on race, grade-point average prior to law school, and law school entrance exam scores. This version is stripped-down for fairness literature and exhibits bias against 'black' students.
dcterms:title: LSAT dataset

dcterms:creator: Jack W. Smith
dcterms:description: A database used to predict whether women of Pima heritage are at risk of diabetes, utilizing various health metrics such as pregnancies, age, and BMI.
dcterms:title: Pima Diabetes Database
